sources.note: registrant DIGITAL REALTY TRUST, INC., matched 2026-10-10

profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a data center company that describes itself as delivering the world's largest data center platform, offering colocation, interconnection, connectivity and cloud services across a global ecosystem. It says it supports deployments ranging from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and presents itself as built for flexibility, open ecosystems and reach. The company is publicly traded under the ticker DLR, is headquartered in Austin, Texas, and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001297996.

On AI, the company's site frames the market as one where inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits, and it positions its infrastructure as aimed at those workloads. It also promotes a 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, citing that 40% of IT leaders name infrastructure as an AI constraint and describing a shift among enterprises from AI strategy to execution.

The record also notes a law exposure count of 126 in Texas. No products, lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for the company.
